dm_single:
سلام! مرسی که کامنت گذاشتی 😊

5 پرامپت که واقعا وقتت رو آزاد می‌کنه 👇

1. ایمیل‌های طولانی:
"Summarize this email thread in 3 bullets and draft a short reply."

2. جلسه:
"From these meeting notes, list the decisions, who owns each task, and the deadlines."

3. اولویت‌بندی:
"Here is my to-do list. Sort it by urgent and important, and tell me what I can drop or delegate."

4. گزارش:
"Turn these rough notes into a one-page report with headings. Keep my facts and add nothing new."

5. نه گفتن مؤدبانه:
"Help me politely say no to this extra task and suggest what I can offer instead."

یه نکته: وقتی که آزاد می‌شه رو خودت از قبل برای یه کار مهم رزرو کن، وگرنه با کار اضافه پر می‌شه.
گزارش: journalofaccountancy.com/news/2026/sep/driving-efficiency-or-driving-workers-toward-burnout-how-ai-is-being-used/
